standard.summary: Source-only outcome standard for the three-hole floating-garden mini-golf putt mechanic (G056). Eight CHECKs each target one principal visible outcome of the putt loop: charge-and-release produces a rolling/rebounding ball, invalid strike attempts are rejected without spending a stroke, terrain (slope and bumper) alters the ball path, an unobstructed roll settles under friction alone, an out-of-bounds ball is restored to its last played position with one penalty stroke shown in the HUD, a sunk ball completes the hole and advances (to the next hole, or to the settlement panel after the last), a fast pass over the cup is not accepted as sunk, and the aiming line plus power readout track the charge while the shot leaves a trail. All fields describe only what a frame can show (which object, what visibly happens, which HUD/panel is on screen). Frozen numbers from G01-G05 (12 m/s at full charge, 1.5 m/s² flat friction, 3.0 m/s² along-slope, 0.6 restitution, 60% aim-line factor, 40% slope transparency drop, 0.5 s trail fade, 8-stroke cap, threshold speeds, camera degrees) are treated as diagnostic-only source evidence and are not restated as acceptance conditions.

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.visible_goal: The player charges a putt in the striking view and releases it, and the golf ball visibly leaves its resting spot and travels across the course in the aimed direction instead of standing still or jumping at random.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.result_frame_description: A sequence of real gameplay frames showing the ball at rest on the fairway with the aim line and power bar, then the ball displaced well away from that spot, moving along the aimed direction, with the stroke counter advanced by one.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.correct_target: The single golf ball on the course surface, moving away from its resting position along the direction the player was aiming when the shot was released.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.necessary_context: The ball at rest, the aim direction and charged power must be visible before release, and the next frames must show that same ball moving on the course, tying the travel to the release.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Charging the power bar and releasing the button launches the ball so it rolls forward across the green in the aimed direction and gradually slows down.
basic_function_bugs: Releasing the charged shot leaves the ball motionless at its resting spot, so no stroke visibly happens.
The ball launches but travels opposite to or far off the displayed aim direction.
The ball passes through the bumper or slope geometry without any rebound or deflection along its route.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.01.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 按 G02 公式生成初速向量 → 球滚动/反弹

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.visible_goal: An attempt to strike the ball while it is still rolling, or while the overview camera mode is active, is refused: no new shot is launched and the displayed stroke count does not increase.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.result_frame_description: Frames of a strike attempt made under the refused condition, with the HUD stroke counter still showing its earlier value and the ball continuing on its existing path rather than being re-launched.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.correct_target: The golf ball together with the on-screen stroke counter in the HUD, both of which must remain unchanged by the refused attempt.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.necessary_context: The refusing condition must be visible — the ball in motion, or the whole-hole overview camera — and the stroke counter must be readable before and after the attempt to see no stroke was charged.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Pressing and releasing the shot control while the ball is rolling or while the overview camera is on produces no launch and no stroke deduction, leaving the ball and the stroke count as they were.
basic_function_bugs: The refused attempt launches a fresh shot and the stroke counter increases.
The rolling ball visibly changes direction or restarts mid-roll in response to the attempt.
A shot is actually launched while the whole-hole overview camera is active.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.02.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 滚动中击球、全览模式击球 → 拒绝且不耗杆

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.visible_goal: The ball's path is visibly altered by the course terrain: crossing a sloped section bends and speeds or slows its travel along the slope, and striking a wooden bumper sends it back off the bumper instead of continuing straight.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.result_frame_description: Gameplay frames where the moving ball reaches the sloped ground and visibly curves along it, then reaches the wooden bumper and moves back off its face, with the ball past the contact in the later frame.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.correct_target: The moving golf ball where it meets the sloped ground and the wooden bumper in the later holes, deflecting along the slope and rebounding away from the bumper's face.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.necessary_context: The slope or bumper must be visible in frame together with the approaching ball so the deflection can be attributed to the terrain, and the post-contact frames must show the ball on the course rather than off it.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.representative_basic_function: A ball rolling into a slope or a bumper is deflected — it bends along the incline and bounces back off the wall with reduced speed — instead of treating the obstacle as flat, empty ground.
basic_function_bugs: The ball passes through or clips inside the bumper and emerges on the far side without rebounding.
The ball keeps a straight, unchanged path across the sloped section as if the ground were flat.
On contact the ball is redirected along or into the obstacle rather than away from its face, or is stopped dead and left embedded in it.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.03.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 坡面改变速度分量（沿坡 3.0 米/秒²）；碰撞按恢复系数 0.6 反弹

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.visible_goal: A ball struck across open flat fairway with no bumper or slope in its path slows down and visibly comes to rest on the green by itself, without being deflected or teleported.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.result_frame_description: Consecutive gameplay frames on a clear stretch of fairway showing the ball partway along its roll, then the same ball sitting still at a stopping point with the camera settled on it, the hole still unfinished.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.correct_target: The moving golf ball on unobstructed flat fairway, ending at rest some distance from where it was struck.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.necessary_context: The struck line of travel must be visible and free of bumper or slope contact, and the stopping frame must show the same ball stationary on the course so the stop can be read as friction rather than a cut or a reset.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.04.C2.t.representative_basic_function: After an unobstructed putt the ball decelerates smoothly and settles at rest on the green, ready for the next shot.
basic_function_bugs: The ball keeps rolling indefinitely and never comes to rest.
The ball visibly bends or reverses on empty fairway as if it hit an invisible obstacle.
The ball rolls on a clear straight shot but sinks below the ground or off the visible course surface instead of stopping on it.

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.visible_goal: When the ball leaves the course and drops into the cloud sea, it is put back at the spot it was last struck from and the HUD shows one additional penalty stroke.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.result_frame_description: Frames of the ball falling past the course edge into the cloud, followed by the ball standing still again at its previous play position, with the HUD stroke or penalty count visibly one higher than before the fall.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.correct_target: The golf ball restored to the position of its previous stroke on the course, together with the HUD stroke and penalty figures that have increased by one.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.necessary_context: The departure over the course boundary must be visible together with the HUD count before the fall, and the restored ball must be shown at rest on the course with the updated HUD so the penalty and the return position can both be read.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.representative_basic_function: A ball that goes out of bounds is respawned at the position of the last stroke and the player is charged a single penalty stroke, with the camera returning to that spot.
basic_function_bugs: The ball is left outside the course or stays falling, never returning to a playable position.
The ball returns to the course but the HUD stroke or penalty count stays the same, so no penalty is charged.
The ball reappears somewhere other than the position of its last stroke, such as the tee of the current or next hole.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.05.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 回上一杆位＋罚 1 杆；连续界外不叠加惩罚上限以外的额外状态；镜头回上一杆位

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.visible_goal: A ball resting in the cup completes the hole and play moves on: the view advances to a new hole, or, after the final hole, a settlement panel appears instead of play staying on the finished hole.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.result_frame_description: Frames of the ball settling into the cup beside the flag, then either the next hole's tee with the HUD hole number advanced, or, when this was the final hole, a summary panel of stroke totals against par.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.correct_target: The ball and cup of the just-finished hole, then the HUD hole indicator or the settlement panel that evidences hole completion and progression.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.necessary_context: The completed hole's cup and the ball inside it must be visible in the frames leading in, so the progression can be tied to a real sink rather than to an unrelated transition or a pause-menu reset.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.representative_basic_function: Sinking the ball in the cup finishes the current hole and advances the game to the next hole, ending with the summary settlement once the last hole is done.
basic_function_bugs: The ball rests in the cup with no hole-complete reaction, leaving play stuck on the same hole.
The hole advances but the HUD still shows the finished hole's number and stroke count instead of the new hole.
After the final hole the game returns to an earlier hole or the title screen with no settlement panel shown.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.06.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 本洞完成 → 下一洞；达 8 杆上限强制完成；三洞完成 → 总结算

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.visible_goal: A ball struck hard enough to speed across the cup does not drop: it carries on past the hole and the hole is not counted as completed.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.result_frame_description: Frames showing the fast ball reaching and crossing the cup mouth, then continuing beyond the cup and coming to rest past it, with the HUD still on the same hole and no next-hole or settlement transition under way.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.correct_target: The fast-moving golf ball and the cup it passes over, with the ball ending up beyond the cup and the hole still open rather than registered as sunk.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.necessary_context: Both the cup and the fast ball must be visible as the ball crosses the cup opening, and the following frame must show the ball alive on the course beyond the cup so the pass can be distinguished from the ball stopping in it.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.representative_basic_function: A ball crossing the cup opening at high speed is rejected by the hole and keeps rolling, so the hole stays in progress.
basic_function_bugs: The fast pass is registered as a hole-in, advancing the hole or opening the settlement panel.
The ball is visibly captured or snapped into the cup mouth and stopped there despite its speed.
The shot is discarded — the ball resets or the stroke is refunded — instead of the ball being allowed to continue past the cup.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.07.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 高速掠过洞杯不判入洞（速度阈值）

atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.visible_goal: While the player holds and varies the charge, the dashed aiming line and the on-screen power value visibly track the charge level, and once the shot is released the ball leaves a fading trail along the path it travels.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.result_frame_description: Frames taken during the charge showing the dashed aim line and the numeric power readout at different charge levels, followed by frames of the launched ball trailing a visible streak of its path that thin out behind it.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.correct_target: The aiming dashed line and the power-bar readout in the shot-preparation view, then the ball's own trail once the shot is released.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.necessary_context: The shot-preparation state with aim line and power value on screen must be shown while the charge changes, and the launched ball must be visible after release so the trail ties to its path.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.representative_basic_function: The aim line and the power number respond to the player's hold — the line extends and the figure climbs with the charge — and the released ball leaves a trail that fades behind it.
basic_function_bugs: The aim line stays a fixed length while the charge is held and changed.
The displayed power value does not move with the charge, or moves opposite to the aim line.
No trail appears behind the ball after the shot is released.
atom.G056_garden_minigolf.WB.TC2.08.C2.t.original_requirement_diagnostic_only: 瞄准虚线长度与坡面透明度按 G05 更新；蓄力条数值同步；击球后生成轨迹残影（0.5 秒渐隐，替换旧残影）
